post.description:
Confirms the address AND replaces the password: for whoever controls the
mailbox but is not the person who registered (or forgot that password).

post.description:
Finishes the bot-started migration: the Telegram owner picks an email and
a password for their EXISTING account (same id, same data).

post.description:
The signed-in person is using the site. Only authenticated people are ever recorded (a guest has no
session, so this answers 401), and a banned account is refused by the session check like any other call.

get.description:
Any signed-in user may view another user's achievement gallery — it
exists to be shown off (teammates, coach marketplace visitors, etc.),
same spirit as a coach listing's PUBLIC photo/video. Guests may only see
the gallery of a coach (the public marketplace profile), never a player's.

get.description:
What coaches wrote about this player after training them — for other
coaches deciding on a request. Only a coach who has a booking with this
player (any status, same as their public profile) may read it; teammates,
other players and the player themself get 403.

schema.title: Response List Metrics Api Players  User Id  Metrics Get

get.description:
Lets the coach UI show either the action or the "player did not allow"
notice, plus the last saved analysis — which is only ever served while
the player's consent is on.

put.description:
Always acts on the caller's own settings (there is no user id in the
path or body). Withdrawing consent also erases every stored analysis of
this player, so a coach can't keep reading an old one.

post.description:
Records that the caller finished (or skipped) the current welcome guide.
Takes no body and no user id: it only ever updates the authenticated
user, and always to the server's current version.

schema.title: Response List My Bookings Api Bookings Me Get
Response List Pending Bookings Api Bookings Coach Pending Get
Response List Coach Bookings Api Bookings Coach Get

get.description:
The caller's own confirmed booking behind a personal training — what
the coach's session screen needs to offer "Тренировка проведена" and the
player review. Only ever returns a booking where the caller is the coach.

patch.description:
Lets the coach pick which of their own training plans to use for a
confirmed booking's session — stored on the linked Training, which the
athlete already sees plan details for when they open it (same as any
other training with a plan).

post.description: The athlete pressed «Оплатить эту тренировку»: returns the ЮKassa page to send them to.
Checks with ЮKassa how the booking's payment ended (the athlete has just come back from the payment page).

The coach marks the session as conducted ("Тренировка проведена"):
the linked training becomes 'completed', which opens reviews for both
sides, and the athlete is asked to review the coach. Repeating it is
harmless and doesn't send a second request.

The coach's review of the athlete after a conducted session. Visible to
coaches who have a booking with that athlete (see players.py).

AdminSessionOut.title: AdminSessionOut
AdminSessionOut.description: What the signed-in administrator may do right now - never the allowlist itself.

AuthOut.title: AuthOut
AuthOut.description:
Returned by /login and /me: the signed-in user plus `csrf_token`. The
session itself travels in an HttpOnly cookie; the CSRF token must be
echoed in the X-CSRF-Token header on every state-changing request (the
page keeps it in memory only, never in storage).

CoachPublicProfileOut.title: CoachPublicProfileOut
CoachPublicProfileOut.description:
A coach's own profile info, viewable by anyone — unlike
CoachListingProfileOut, this isn't scoped to one listing.

ComplaintIn.title: ComplaintIn
ComplaintIn.description: What a user sends to report a profile, a listing or a public photo/video.

ConfirmedReasonIn.title: ConfirmedReasonIn
ConfirmedReasonIn.description: An irreversible action: the reason plus an explicit confirmation.

ConsentIn.title: ConsentIn
ConsentIn.description: One ticked box and the documents (with editions) it covered on the sign-up form.

DashboardActivityOut.title: DashboardActivityOut
DashboardActivityOut.description: Distinct signed-in people active in the window (UTC days; the last 7 / 30 days include today).

PaymentStartOut.title: PaymentStartOut
PaymentStartOut.description: Where to send the customer to pay (ЮKassa's payment page).

PlayerPublicProfileOut.title: PlayerPublicProfileOut
PlayerPublicProfileOut.description:
A player's profile as viewed by someone other than themself — a
coach they've booked (or been booked by), or a coach who shares a team
with them. Unlike PlayerProfileOut, this carries their avatar too.

app__schemas__admin__ReasonIn.title: ReasonIn
app__schemas__admin__ReasonIn.description: Every moderation action carries a written reason (it goes into the audit trail).

HTTPBearer.description: Session token. Browsers authenticate with the HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login; non-browser clients can send the same token as a Bearer token.
